# Salesflare | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | Auto-entry CRM designed for small B2B sales teams, reduced maintenance through mailboxes, calendars, websites and LinkedIn signals. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundaries | Complex services, CPQ and mega-business governance are not their main battlefields; website tracking and mail activities meet Cookie and privacy consent requirements. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Complex services, CPQs, and oversized corporate governance are not their main battlegrounds; website tracking and email activity are subject to cookie and privacy consent requirements. |
